entries.value: How media players on this machine decode video. These are per-machine settings; they are not part of any world.
Which decode route a media player may take. Takes effect the next time a source is opened.
How many media players may play at once. The furthest ones stop and start again when you go back to them. 0 removes the limit, which on a headset will cost you bandwidth and frame rate.

How much media is held back before playing, to ride out a patchy connection. Applies to every media player you have not tuned individually from the Media Players panel. 0 is Auto, which works it out from the connection and is the right answer for almost everyone. Raising it makes playback steadier and slower to start.
Whether captions are drawn on a media player you have not decided individually. Any one player can be switched on or off from the Media Players panel without changing this.
